messages.text: So what is todays excuse?
Used the store-orders skill
Handed to the team · Two promises from the Oct 14 chat went unanswered for 13 days; app access and Bi

No excuse. You were told you'd get an email on the app access and the Bitaxe 602 supply, and nothing came. That's on us, thirteen days of it.

I've pinged the team now and they're on until 6pm ET today, so stay in the chat and one of them will jump in here with both answers. If you step away it comes to your email.

I can see your DC06 and BC04 order from this afternoon came through fine, by the way.
You have been telling me they will get with me for over a week.

Fair, and I won't do it again.

Here's what I can answer now: the Bitaxe Gamma 602 runs on a Mean Well LRS-50-5, 5V 10A. That's the supply we ship with ours, so that's your spec. We don't sell it standalone.

The app access I genuinely don't know, and guessing would waste another week. The team is online right now and has this chat open.

Faster route if you want it today: our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post and mention @nullhashrate.
I received an email to be on a call with Abel to talk about Harlo, the scheduled time has come and gone, sitting here waiting, no one ever showed.
Handed to the team · Abel no-showed a scheduled Harlo call; customer sat waiting and is also still ow

I'm sorry. Sitting on a call nobody joins is the worst version of this, and you'd already been left waiting twice.

Abel has been pinged directly with this, right now, while he's on. Stay in the chat and he comes in here.

One thing so he can pick it straight up: what day and time was the call set for?
today at 12:00

Noted, today at noon, an hour and a half ago. That's on Abel's ping now so he knows exactly what he missed.

He's on until 6pm ET. Stay in the chat and he'll come in here to pick the Harlo call back up, or set a new time with you if he can't talk right this minute.
still waiting.

I know, and I'm not going to pad it with more waiting. He's been pinged twice and it stays open until he answers.

While you're here: what was the Harlo call meant to cover? If it's Harlo OS, firmware, pools or the dashboard, I can get you a real answer in this chat now, or the fastest line of all is our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, mention @nullhashrate.
All it said was to discuss Harlo likes, dislikes, suggestions.

Then it's a feedback call, and the irony of nobody showing up for it isn't lost on me.

Two ways: wait for Abel here, or tell me the likes, dislikes and suggestions now and I'll put them on your record so he reads them before he calls. Nothing gets lost that way, and the call becomes a conversation instead of a questionnaire.

What's your biggest dislike with Harlo so far?
It doesn't appear to work on my scrypt miners
Used route to tech
*(Handing this one to our technical specialist, who's picking it up now.)*
yes, if it is not to late to switch, I thinbk there is a bundle with thor 2, 8, and 6?
Searched the catalog · Hammer bundle Thor DC02 DC08
Used the store-orders skill

Back with you on the order side.

Checked Shop····: the warehouse has already printed the label, so it's past the point where I can change what's in it. Tracking ····.

And there's no Thor plus DC08 plus DC06 bundle. The three-unit one live today is the HAMMER MEGA PACK, Thor P2 + BC04 + DC06, $899.99.

Your box already has the BC04 and DC06. If you want the Thor P2 alongside them later, it's $449 on its own and in stock.
Ok, we are good, I will work with it, I have gotten a good variety from you guys, and I want to keep it growing.

Good, and thanks for sticking with us through today, it wasn't our best showing.

Still open on our side, not yours: Abel on the Harlo call and the app access, and JD on the DC02 flasher. Both are pinged and your Harlo feedback is on your record.

Your BC04 and DC06 are labelled and moving. Your 40T on Shop···· is still to go out.

Come back in here any time and I'll pick it straight up.

Actually, you are the only one that has communicated with me, I have been waiting for Abel for over a week, I was supposed to be on a call with him today he never showed up.  I have been expecting a price or confirmation on a part for over a week.  I did finnally get to order my t-40, last week, after waiting over a month for a reply.  So my only complaint is lack of communications.
Looked something up in Shopify

That's fair, and it's the complaint I'd make too. The gear has held up, we haven't.

I've written it onto your record exactly as you put it: the missed call today at noon, over a week on the part price and the app access, and over a month before you could even place the 40T order. Abel reads that before he next picks this up.

Nothing about that is on you, and I'm glad you're still building the bench.
And I upgrade on Trust Pilot, when I do get answers and brag about the good things.

Appreciated, though I'd rather earn it than ask for it. Write what you actually find, good or bad, that's the only version worth anything.

The honest scoreboard today: two answers still owed you, and a flasher bug now properly in JD's room. When those land, they land.
I have 2 602's, three DC-02's, Thor P2, all from you guys.  So the two I ordered today plus my t-40, will make nice additions.

That's a proper bench: two Gammas, three DC02s, a Thor P2, and now the BC04 and DC06 on the way, with the 40T on top.

The 40T will be the biggest single jump you've made, 40 TH/s on its own. It ships November 14.

Nice spread too, Bitcoin and scrypt both covered, so you've got shots on two chains instead of one.
And I hooked the Thor to Harlos Pool.

Good, that's the right home for it. Ten TH/s pointed at our own pool.

Worth a look at the dashboard once it's been up a day: accepted shares climbing and no rejects is all you need to see.

Is it reporting the full hashrate there, or reading low?
Let me look, brb.
Take your time, I'm here.
Looks like it is right on, I have it split 4 ways, but have been using my bolts, hit a few times, playing with the game.  I wish it showed a payout history.
Looked something up in Shopify

That's the kind of thing the call was supposed to collect, so I've put it on your record in your words: payout history on the pool dashboard, and that you're splitting four ways and hitting with bolts.

I won't promise it gets built, but Abel and JD will see it asked for by someone actually using it.

Anything else on the pool side bugging you while you're in there?
